Hi team —

Two promotion packets from my org are ready for committee review and I want to get them slotted on the next available panel. Quick summary:

- Arpit Patel (IC, Backend): strong engineering impact, compensation note attached.
- Megan Chen (Staff PM candidate): leadership across two product pods; packet moved to final after manager sign-off.

Attached: Arpit packet (draft, needs one small edit from compensation), Megan packet (final), and the committee availability sheet.

Ask: can we get both reviewed in the Feb 24–26 committee window? If there are conflicts, I propose prioritizing Megan for a Feb 24 slot (time sensitive for hiring band alignment) and moving Arpit to the Feb 25 afternoon if needed.

Two items I need from the group before I circulate invites:
1) Confirm any reviewer conflicts (specifically: Laura, are you available Feb 24 morning? Marcus — any calendar constraints?).
2) Neha, do you need any additional comp justification for Arpit before the packet goes final? HR indicated a quick clarifying note would be enough.

Thanks — I pushed the files to the drive link below and copied Jane from PeopleOps for scheduling.

Best,
Dylan

3) I’ll update the committee-availability sheet and send final invites (including calendar links and the drive folder). Jane — can your team confirm the room and video bridge for Feb 24 morning? Tara — please capture the packet versions in the vendor tracking sheet when we upload.
